revisions.name: logo
revisions.prompt:
Edit this exact Korean fantasy game logo. Keep the existing cream top line "운빨냥국", gold bottom line "배틀", crown, paw, stars, coral ribbon accents and dark teal backing. Make ONLY these corrections:
1) The LAST syllable "틀" in bottom word "배틀" must be a completely NORMAL, unmodified, upright Korean sans-serif glyph. Use the plain standard Pretendard ExtraBold glyph for "틀": the correct recognizable stacked syllable ㅌ + ㅡ + ㄹ. No speed stripes, no stretching horizontal strokes, no stylized missing strokes, no custom decorative letter construction. It must instantly read exactly "틀", not "들", "튤" or an abstract emblem. Make it gold like "배", align to same baseline and weight. Legibility is more important than retaining the original stylization. Keep overall two-line text "운빨냥국" / "배틀" accurate.
2) REMOVE the existing malformed perspective dice completely. Replace with EXACTLY TWO separate perfectly SQUARE FRONT-FACING WHITE DICE FACES, side by side at lower right of lettering. Equal width and height, parallel horizontal/vertical edges, small rounded corners allowed, dark thin border. Do NOT use perspective, rotation, a trapezoid, a diamond, a cube showing multiple faces, or fused overlapping shapes. They are two clean flat square dice. Left die has EXACTLY THREE evenly spaced black circular pips in a diagonal. Right die has EXACTLY FOUR black circular pips, one in each corner. Clear visible gap between the two square dice. Same scale, no dots on side faces. No other dice anywhere.
Keep the rest of logo design and colors. Remove all outside background to genuine alpha transparency. No sky, no characters, no extra text, no TOUCH TO START, no glow, no grain/noise. Full complete logo silhouette with transparent margin. Clean sharp vector-like artwork. Inspect the requested text and dice geometry carefully.

revisions.name: landscape
revisions.prompt:
Simplify this exact transparent fantasy title LANDSCAPE asset substantially while retaining recognizable layout. Keep left wooden MINE entrance with short rails and ONE small gold ore cart, green rolling hills and central winding path, purple crystal region and blue lake on right. No castle, no characters, no logo, no text, no sky/clouds. Area ABOVE the skyline remains genuinely transparent.

CRITICAL SIMPLIFICATION:
- Cut total individual trees to EXACTLY EIGHT readable simple triangular evergreen silhouettes: FOUR at the far left around/below the mine, FOUR at the far right near the crystal slope. No trees elsewhere. No forest carpet, no distant tiny trees, no repeated rows of trees, no tree-like pointed shrubs.
- Behind terrain use ONLY THREE broad smooth mountain peaks: two large gray angular mountains on LEFT, one low broad blue-gray ridge in the far distance behind center-right. No chain of many little peaks, no serrated sawtooth skyline, no extra small rocky mountains.
- At right use ONLY THREE large purple crystal prisms with large flat faces. Keep the lake as ONE clean blue shape plus TWO broad pale-blue water lines.
- Foreground uses THREE large smooth green hill color shapes, one broad cream winding path, a FEW simple large rocks, and at most THREE rounded shrub clumps. No individual grass blades, no flower dots, no pebble scatter, no tiny gold ore scattered across slopes.
- Mine is iconic: wooden rectangular support frame, solid dark entrance, short track with a few readable ties, one cart with 3-4 big gold chunks.
- All surfaces are perfectly clean large uniform vector-style color regions with at most ONE flat hard-edged shadow tone each. ABSOLUTELY NO NOISE, NO GRANULAR PIXEL TEXTURE, NO PAPER GRAIN, NO PAINTERLY MOTTLE, NO SAND-LIKE SPECKLES, NO GRASS TEXTURE, NO COMPLEX LITTLE FACETS. Smooth deliberate edges. No gradients or lighting effects.
Maintain landscape 16:9 framing and bottom ground reaching frame edge. The center should have open gently rolling hills and path for later castle and characters. Generously spaced scenery, same basic green/teal/gray/purple/blue palette as reference. This is a CLEAN SIMPLE indie-game cut-paper/vector-style BACKGROUND LAYER with transparent sky, not an intricate fantasy landscape painting.
